title: connector-adapter + iterable-stream wrappers for Python/TS/Go SDKs; minor API stabilizations and version bumps
author: Diego Morales
description: Motivation: developers reported three friction points across SDKs: 1) inconsistent auth retry plumbing for streaming endpoints, 2) awkward streaming ergonomics when consumers want resumable/iterable patterns, and 3) minor divergence in default retry/backoff semantics across Python/TS/Go. This PR introduces a small, explicit connector-adapter abstraction that centralizes auth token lifecycle and retry hooks, plus ergonomic iterable wrappers for streaming responses in all three official SDKs. High-level changes: - Introduce ConnectorAdapter interface (Python: ConnectorAdapter, TS: ConnectorAdapter, Go: connector.Adapter) to standardize token refresh callbacks, pre-request hooks, and a pluggable RetryPolicy implementation. - Add ResumableStream and StreamIterable helpers that convert chunked/streaming responses into Python async iterators, TS AsyncIterable, and Go channel-based iterators. Streams expose a small resume token when possible for cheap resume-on-retry. - Harmonize default RetryPolicy: exponential backoff with capped jitter, 3 retries for idempotent calls, 1 retry for non-idempotent streaming control frames. - Minimal public surface changes: old streaming helpers still present as thin shims; new helpers opt-in. - Version bumps: python -> 1.8.0, typescript -> 0.12.3, go -> v0.9.1. Backwards compatibility / migration notes: - Callers using the old low-level stream.ConnectRaw should replace with StreamIterable when they want iterator semantics; a compatibility shim remains for one release. - Go changed the StreamRecv signature to return (chunk, resumeToken, err) — callers that inspect raw frames must adapt; higher-level helpers are unchanged. Checklist: - [x] Implement connector-adapter and SDK bindings - [x] Add iterable helpers + tests - [x] Update README snippets for each SDK - [x] Run compatibility matrix across common workloads - [x] Release notes + version bumps - [x] Post-merge: announce to SDK slack and tag changelogs Commit summary: see commits field for details. CI: initial run failed a flaky integration test in ts-sdk streaming (race between reconnect backoff and token refresh), fixed with a small timing guard and re-ran. This PR touches runtime-adjacent code but is confined to SDK packages and examples. Merge: squash merge; release branch tags created for each SDK.
